words.sense: Surpassing all others in a field or category
misconceptions: Assuming being celebrated proves being the single leader.
Treating every prize as an overall first-place ranking.
Assuming being celebrated proves being the single leader.
Overlooking evidence of being foremost among peers.

semantic_axes.description: Preeminent identifies the foremost figure in a field; eminent signals high standing without establishing that anyone outranks everyone else.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Maya among local bakers?

beats.text: In a blind tasting, Maya's bread ranks first against every bakery in the city.
beats.decisive_clue: first place across the whole local field
beats.reason: The initial evidence is first place across the whole local field; it best supports preeminent.

beats.text: The judges repeat the test with different loaves, and hers again wins overall.
beats.decisive_clue: repeat first-place results against all peers
beats.reason: Repeated top rankings support her position above every competitor in that field.

chains.feedback_short: Repeated top rankings support her position above every competitor in that field.
chains.feedback_deep: Preeminent means foremost among peers; eminent means widely respected for achievement. Repeated top rankings support her position above every competitor in that field.
chains.contrast_rule: Preeminent means at the top; eminent means among the respected.

hints.axis: Preeminent identifies the foremost figure in a field; eminent signals high standing without establishing that anyone outranks everyone else.
hints.contrast: Preeminent means at the top; eminent means among the respected.
